items.expected: Interpret the four correctly identified energies and the vertical S1−T1 and T2−S1 gaps using their computational evidence. Cy2 energies do not measure SOC/ISC enhancement or establish the annihilator's TTA criterion. Credit the supported energetic findings; do not require an affirmative heavy-atom causal claim or a generic limitation statement.
items.statement: The validated Cy2 calculations determine the vertical S1/T1/T2 ordering and separations together with the relaxed T1 adiabatic energy, supporting a state-energetic interpretation relevant to triplet sensitization.
